sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (WRNF '2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates')

hookups.source: rec.gov description ('Electrical hook-ups are not available') + WRNF 2026 table (Peak One: no electric), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 77 sites in the rec.gov catalog (its description says 80, the forest's 2026 table 79), all gravel back-ins but one pull-through (21). The forest's table gives a 50-ft maximum site length; catalog lengths run 17-45 ft (39 sites at 30, 9 at 45; site 43 is 17 ft, site 9 24 ft) with four 99-ft placeholders.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('Dillon Peak One CG 9,020 79/50' 5/20-10/2 $30 R') + rec.gov catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, Driveway Surface) + rec.gov description ('Peak One Campground has 80 sites able to accommodate tents, trailers, and RVs'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Flush toilets temporarily out of service with vault toilets in their place, and no water from August 1, 2026 (bring your own). Filling RV tanks with water is prohibited. Firewood sold by the hosts. Boat ramps at the Frisco and Dillon marinas.

facilities.source: FS page (Restrooms 'Flush toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; Current Conditions 'As of Aug 1, 2026 water is not available. Please bring your own water.') + rec.gov description ('flush toilets(temporary out of service-vault toilets in place, and drinking water'; 'Boat ramp access is available in the marinas located in the nearby towns of Frisco and Dillon') + notice ('Filling RV tanks with water prohibited'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates: 'Dillon Peak One CG ... 5/20-10/2'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov at least two days ahead; 14 nights a month at most. Occupy the site the first night (a reservation is held until 11 a.m. the next day). One RV with tow per site; an extra vehicle is charged nightly at the campground. Run by a concessionaire (American Land & Leisure, 801-226-3564).

booking.source: rec.gov rules (reservationCutOff 2, maxStay 14 'Each Month'; minWeekendStay and minHolidayWeekendStay 0 'soft' = no rule) + rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-20 to 2026-10-01) + notices ('Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date'; 'One RV with tow per single site'; 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.WhiteRiver.Dillon@AmericanLL.com'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $28 a single site (2026, the same in 2027-28); extra vehicle charged nightly at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232221/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28) + FS page ('Single Site: $28 per night'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Senior/Access pass must be entered when booking; single sites only.

discounts.source: rec.gov notice ('Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only'), read 2026-10-27

note: Dillon Ranger District campground (White River NF) on the Frisco Peninsula of Dillon Reservoir, off Highway 9 south of Frisco; the entrance is one-eighth mile south of the Frisco Peninsula area. Body contact with the reservoir prohibited. Little or no shade since beetle-killed trees were removed. --Claude
summary: FS page + WRNF 2026 table + rec.gov description/rules/rates/catalog: confirmed 77 sites, no electric, $28 (2026), rec.gov booking. Changed max rig 99 -> 50 ft (forest's stated maximum site length; 99 is a catalog placeholder). Added flush toilets (temporarily vault), potable water (none since Aug 1, 2026), season 05-20 to 10-02, booking season 05-20 to 10-01, 14-night/month max, 2-day cutoff, Senior/Access discount. Water/sewer hookups left unknown (catalog lists no hookup attributes).
